decision: Approve GRANT CREATE ON DATABASE groundbnb TO neon_service on the synthetic preview and local branches only, excluding production.
rationale: Client replied I approve after the exact grant and scope were presented following automatic approval rejection.
alternatives: Leave managed Neon Auth uninitialized on preview/local
impact: The provider-managed role can initialize its auth schema in those two databases. No application role, credential, production permission, paid plan, or metered dispatch is authorized by this decision. SYS-11 remains unverified until real app isolation checks pass.
implementationStatus: Both guarded grants committed; managed Auth enabled with empty users. The original NOLOGIN assumption was disproven by a read-only preflight; the guard now pins exact branch identities and requires the existing non-superuser role without changing its attributes.
